about.title: About Us
about.quoteMainLine1: Travelling is more than going from one point
about.intro: Capital Way is a road transport operator linking Maputo, Maxixe, Chimoio and Tete with regular passenger service, parcel shipping and in-person support at our terminals. Every journey is built around real safety, onboard comfort and fair pricing — from tickets to cargo, with the same standard throughout.
about.passengersText: We run scheduled connections between major cities in central and southern Mozambique, with ground teams and coaches designed for long-distance travel. Our goal is boarding and alighting that feels simple, safe and dependable.
about.cargoText: We move consignments with clear per-route pricing (per kg and by volume where applicable), aligned to coach schedules and support through terminal contacts. It's the logistics arm of the same network you trust to travel.
about.networkText: We're present in Malanga (Maputo), N1 (Maxixe), EN6 at Praça dos Trabalhadores (Chimoio) and Matema (Tete). Each site is a sales, information and help desk — air-conditioned waiting areas consistent with the onboard comfort we promise.
about.experienceText: Our fleet features Zhongtong reclining seats, air conditioning, onboard TV entertainment, USB charging and Starlink Wi-Fi — whether you need to work, study or rest until you arrive.
about.mission: Deliver safe journeys and shipments with professional service, punctuality and respect for passengers and cargo. Every departure is planned to reduce surprises and reinforce trust in our brand.
about.vision: To be a national reference in intercity coach travel by combining safety, a modern onboard experience and efficient links between provincial capitals and strategic towns across Mozambique — growing sustainably and staying close to communities.
